_purpose: Authoritative, human-authored inputs for the date engine. Dates, tithis, and helplines are NEVER generated by a language model. Each is retrieved verbatim from a cited source (and/or computed by the engine). Any not-yet-known value is null with a _status marker, never guessed.
_editing_rule: A non-technical editor may change values here. Do NOT edit computed outputs (data/dist/calendar.json) by hand. After any change, add a dated entry to CHANGELOG.md and re-run the build pipeline.

panchang_convention.masa_system: Amanta (new-moon-ending lunar month, as used in Maharashtra)
panchang_convention.day_rule: Tithi prevailing at local sunrise defines the calendar day's tithi.
panchang_convention.caveat: Festival-specific rules (e.g. some vratas use the tithi at moonrise, midday, or a specific ritual moment; amanta vs purnimanta month naming) can override the sunrise rule. All such judgment calls are FLAGGED for a panchang authority to confirm — see UNVERIFIED.md.

confidence_levels.confirmed: Verified against an authoritative government/administration source, cited, with access date.
confidence_levels.awaiting-official-declaration: Reported consistently by secondary sources but not yet confirmed by an authoritative source. Show with a visible 'expected — confirm closer to the event' label.
confidence_levels.computed: Produced deterministically by the engine (Swiss Ephemeris). Independent of any list; still to be reconciled with official declaration.
confidence_levels.unresolved-conflict: Sources disagree; both/all positions recorded, none chosen. See conflicts[].
